style.name: Surrealism
style.description: Surrealism explores dreams, the unconscious, and unexpected connections between familiar things. In digital design, impossible scale and surprising juxtapositions can create a memorable visual world around a clear interface.

fonts.heading: Syne
fonts.rationale: Unconventional display proportions support the visual surprise while a neutral body face gives the reader an anchor.

tips: Build around one strong visual contradiction.
Let negative space heighten the unusual.
avoid: Using arbitrary weirdness without an idea.
Making essential content difficult to discover.
Motion that cannot be paused or reduced.

recipe.composition: Use one improbable spatial composition, such as an arch around a floating form, beside a legible text block.
recipe.motion: Reveal a changed object briefly; avoid endless floating or motion that competes with reading.
recipe.signature: Unexpected scale and spatial relationships made believable by consistent lighting.
